transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Um... hi. I, uh... I guess I'm here because work has been getting really hard lately. I just... I can't seem to go near the front windows at the store anymore. Or even look out at that part of the street. I keep, um, finding excuses to just stay in the stockroom in the back, even though being out on the floor is my actual job. It's just... I can't.
When you're near the front windows or out on the store floor, do you feel sudden intense fear or panic that makes you want to leave quickly?
No, not really panic. It's just... I just don't like being up there. I'd rather stay in the back.
Do you feel any fear or anxiety when you think about being near the front windows or being on the store floor?
I mean... I guess maybe a little? It's just... I just don't like it. I don't really know how to explain it. I just try not to think about it too much.
Is there something specific about the front windows or the street outside that you're worried about, like a fear of people, cars, or something else?

I mean... I guess cars. Or just... that one car. Um... it's been like this for about two weeks now. Ever since... well, I was working the overnight shift, and a car just... crashed right through the store window. So... yeah. That's why.
Are you afraid that something like the car crash might happen again if you're near the front window?
I don't know... I guess I don't really think about it happening again. I just... I just don't want to be up there. It's just easier if I stay in the back room.
Do you find yourself thinking about the car crash a lot, even when you're not at work?

Um... yeah. I guess. It just... it keeps popping into my head out of nowhere. Even when I'm not there. But... especially when I'm trying to set up displays, I just... suddenly I can hear the bang again. And I see the glass coming down... like it's happening all over again. I just... I try to block it out.
Do you feel nervous, anxious, or upset when you're reminded of the car crash, even if you're not near the front window?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't really noticed feeling like that. I just... I just try to push it out of my head and focus on something else.
Do you find yourself avoiding other things that remind you of the car crash, like certain places, people, or activities?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I mostly just go to work and go home. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
